nodes.label: Review fixes batch 2 design
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Four fix-shaped streams land now; per-country political tinting is deferred to its own design-first cycle (batch 3) because it needs genuine palette exploration. The selectionOriginRef threading simplification is consciously declined, not deferred — the mechanism works, is tested and documented, so collapsing it is churn without behavior change.

nodes.label: applyBasemapLayerVisibility single owner
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Hiding symbol layers during play would be undone by useSatelliteMode's own layer flipping on a mid-game satellite toggle. Following the repo's single-owner pattern, basemap layer visibility gets ONE owner with one rule: a non-custom layer is visible iff !satellite, and symbol layers additionally require !playing. Tested as a truth table plus the toggle-mid-game ordering case.

nodes.label: Satellite border emphasis while playing
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: applyCountryBaselinePaint, already the single owner of the border/fill baseline, gains a gameActive input; border width was previously set only at layer creation, so the owner starts writing line-width per mode change. Goal: active play never shows the answer (no labels in map view) while borders stay legible in satellite.

nodes.label: Panel polish — five verified defects
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Title truncation (line-clamp-2 instead of truncate), region-chip mid-phrase wrap, border chips for six non-selectable neighbors (ESH/GIB/GUF/HKG/MAC plus a static UNK->Kosovo fallback) so no raw code shows, a timezones '+N more' toggle, and dropping the focus ring from the programmatically-focused heading (Chromium matches :focus-visible for script focus, but the heading is never keyboard-focusable so the ring communicates nothing).

nodes.label: Compare-view camera framing both countries
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: cameraForBounds over the two centroids with 80px padding (absorbing centroid-vs-outline underframing) plus the panel-aware offset. Exiting compare deliberately leaves the camera in place, following the preserve-the-user's-view philosophy. An antimeridian pair is asserted to produce a valid camera — verified, not assumed.

nodes.label: Layout constants with a class-string drift alarm
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Tailwind class literals cannot consume TS constants, so a unit test asserts the panel components' class strings still contain the constant-derived values. Geometry drift then fails a test instead of silently mis-framing the camera. The test is intentionally brittle — that is its job — so its failure message must name which constant to update.

nodes.label: Zoom-interpolated extrusion fade
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Replaces batch 1's hard maxzoom:6 cliff with fill-extrusion-height interpolated from full height at z4.5 to 0 at z6.5 plus maxzoom:7 as a backstop, so the lift shrinks smoothly during flights instead of vanishing in one frame. EXTRUSION_MAX_ZOOM is exported so tests stop pinning a literal.
